1.consolidated_definition: Pareo. Comparación de dos cosas para igualarlas. Anglicismo crudo, frecuente. Estamos trabajando para completar el matching entre ambos grupos para adelantar el desarrollo de negocios (Departamento de Desarrollo Económico y Comercio, consultado 10-12-07)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Matching. Comparison of two things to equalize them. Anglicism, often used in a raw form. We are working on completing the matching between both groups to advance business development (Department of Economic Development and Commerce, consulted 10-12-07)
